measurement: Existing 15-second requestAnimationFrame QA, Codex in-app browser on desktop; not GPU timing or physical-phone testing.
limitations: Desktop p95 frame time increased despite improved average FPS; zero regression on all devices is not established.
Local ready times do not establish production network performance.
Static receiver shadows fade when sunlight moves away from the baked direction; these are not realtime ray-traced shadows.
Original PBR textures and baked indirect light are retained; this change does not establish Unreal or V-Ray visual equivalence.
